appearance: Gallery: deep matte-plaster box frame with a warm LED reveal, floating oak shelf with a terracotta vase and a brass knot
Neon Night: gunmetal frame with magenta outer and cyan inner neon tubes, amber corner slashes, cyan floor line
Washi & Wood: hinoki posts and beams, glowing shoji panels on both sides, a round paper lantern
Holo Portal: three floating emissive rounded rings (cyan, violet, blue), glass halo, light nodes, hovering base puck
Moss & Stone: stacked natural stone slabs, moss cushions and fern fronds
Cosmos: deep-navy frame, star field, ringed planet, orbit line and a small moon
behaviors: Opening is hollow with no geometry and no collider, so rays reach the other app's window behind it
Every mesh whose material name starts with emit_ is a theme light: its emissive intensity follows the show state (Lights up 100 %, Opening 60 %->, Showing 12 %, Closing back over 6 s)
Switching style cross-fades over 1.2 s and switches the ambience loop; the choice is remembered
Uniform resize only; the model is scaled to the Volume (750 dp per model metre at the default size)
previewLimitations: Renders are lit by a neutral room environment; on device the passthrough room is not dimmed
Bloom on emissive tubes is a render effect; on device glow depends on runtime post-processing support
